title: The cover with the year blank
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Friday. The cover is the derby sign, scraped, the year still blank. The owner says he forgot the year. Wood says the sign hasn't decided. She says it's February. He says the sign knows.

panels.composition: The cover: the derby sign, scraped, the crab, the year's space blank.

image.prompt: close on a photocopied booklet cover showing a hand-painted crab sign with the space for the year left blank, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The laundromat. The LAUNDRY owner with it. WOOD. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner holding a small booklet and pointing at its cover while a young man and a dog wait, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The owner setting it in the rack, blank year out.

image.prompt: a laundromat owner placing a small booklet into a wire rack, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The rack from the door: the blank year, tiny, facing the room. Next Friday it will have a number and Gully's twenty dollars behind it.

image.prompt: a wire flyer rack seen from a laundromat doorway with a small booklet facing out, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'The sign knows.' Feb 11: Gully's first flyer.
